title: privacy by design pia security day one
name: Privacy by design: PIA and security from day one
rule: Privacy by design + PIA; security from day one — named NSW Design Standards. Complete and maintain a Privacy Impact Assessment; consent and data-use are explicit; identifiable vs de-identified access is separated. Security is designed and tested from the first release, not bolted on. Dual-cite USWDS earn-trust / data stewardship without merging the PIA/security-from-day-one names.
pass_when: A maintained PIA exists; consent/data-use are explicit; identifiable vs de-identified access is separated; security is in the first release.
fail_when: No PIA; security bolted on after launch; identifiable and de-identified access mixed.
overview: Maintain a PIA; explicit consent; separate access; security from first release.
apply_when: Products handling personal data under NSW privacy and security standards.
not_when: No PIA, security bolted on after launch, or mixed identifiable access.
agent_hint: Complete a maintained PIA, separate identifiable access, and ship security day one.
description: Privacy by design plus PIA; security from day one—named NSW Design Standards. Fail when there is no PIA, security is bolted on after launch, or identifiable and de-identified access are mixed.
do_not_claim: Generic “be accessible”; USWDS design-principle slogans as this PIA row.
